summary: Implemented the restack subcommand of review-stack-prepare.sh across all three plan phases in one dispatch: ref resolution/refusals (exit 53/54), bottom-up merge detection with the --merged NN override and off-tree descendant recompute (exit 48/52), and compare-and-swap ref moves with the manifest rewrite, show's new state column, header reconciliation, and a redeploy. The suite grew from 38 to 61 passing cases with no pre-existing case or static assertion edited. While building the required conflicting-descendant case, uncovered and fixed a latent $(...)-subshell bug in rsp_move_commit_onto_new_parent (shared with cut) that was silently swallowing refusals; logged via issue-record.sh.
